CDC analyzed ED visits for 2005 using data from the National Electronic Injury Surveillance System All Injury Program
NEISS-AIP collects data about treatment of patients for all types and causes of injuries in U.S. hospital EDs

methods_quotes.q: Data are weighted by the inverse of the probability of selection to produce national estimates
Estimates for this report were based on weighted data for 4,478 nonfatal self-inflicted injuries
CDC analyzed screening forms that were completed by trained NEISS hospital coders using ED patient charts
National estimates are unstable because they are based on <20 cases or the coefficient of variation is >30%.
